summary: easy::Value table equality incorrectly depended on insertion order because Map delegated equality to LinkedHashMap. The fix switches to IndexMap, whose equality ignores insertion order. Blocked: the fix deletes the relevant tests/serde.rs hashmap test, and inspection found no remaining test demonstrating this equality bug. A compilable verbatim reversal also requires restoring the removed linked-hash-map dependency alongside implementation changes, which cannot be expressed by the permitted single implementation-file reversal. No builds or tests were run.
